visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright indoor studio or event space. A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white high-neck top with purple floral patterns and a dark blue overall dress, stands centrally. She performs a signature dance move, extending her palms toward the camera in a rhythmic pulsing motion. In the background, two flight attendants in formal black uniforms stand symmetrically on either side. A large backdrop features text and a stylized city skyline. (2) The scene shifts through rapid cuts to various travel hubs. First, the woman is seen in a large, modern airport terminal with glass walls and information desks. She maintains her energetic dance gesture. A transition follows to an observation deck where she stands before a large 'Rokko' sign, the lighting shifting to a warmer indoor glow. (3) The character moves to iconic outdoor landmarks across Japan. She is seen at the Kobe Mosaic Square at night with city lights reflecting on the water, then at the bright, open Kobe Port. She changes into a black lace floral dress. She visits Himeji Castle, gesturing in front of the white historic walls, and then appears in a vibrant floral kimono at a traditional shrine gate. (4) The final sequences take place in Osaka. The character is seen at the Nintendo Osaka store in front of a Mario-themed display, then at a modern hotel entrance and the EXPO 2025 construction site. The lighting is bright and natural. She continues her repetitive palm-outward dance, maintaining a joyful expression while interacting with the camera lens.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel promotional piece to celebrate the inaugural EVA Air flight route between Taoyuan and Kobe. It uses a high-energy dance challenge format to showcase multiple tourist destinations and highlights in Japan, specifically focusing on the Kobe/Osaka region and the upcoming EXPO 2025, aimed at enticing young travelers.
